_note: Run O1 cross-site link allowlist (BACKLOG 5.1 'Snapshot and leak lists', Q-bridges D0, B01, B02, B03, B17, section 7.2). Read by apps/quiz/scripts/o1/check-network-links.mts and the leak suite. An anonymous page may link to another FanQuiz site only through an entry below. Fields: from (source sites), page (path patterns: '*' any page, '/x/**' a subtree, exact path, null = no page yet), to (target sites), href (target path patterns), rel ('followed' = must not carry nofollow, 'nofollow' = must carry it), query (false = no query string at all), maxPerPage (links per page to each target site). domainText: on a page of the key site, the domains of the listed sites must not appear anywhere in the HTML outside the allowlisted links. F0's docs/o1/contracts/link-allowlist.md names the same entries; when F0 ships docs/o1/contracts/link-allowlist.json the checker reads that file first.
